title: Measure state recall against a frozen public fixture
context: State recall evaluation was still pending, leaving retrieval quality unmeasured. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Evaluate lexical and local-model semantic retrieval against a frozen synthetic public fixture, saving results with corpus, question, runner hashes and the model revision.
consequences: The saved evaluation covers 33 records and 12 questions, separating literal queries from paraphrases.
Lexical recall@3 is 1.0 for literal queries and 0.5 for paraphrases.
Results establish fixture-level evidence; production corpus performance and external Python adoption remain unmeasured.
